description:
One product over time

One product's intrinsic value on every NBP business day between `start` and `end` (default: the last 30 days; at most 366 days), since 2013-01-02.

GET /v1/gold/prices/{product} on Gold & commodities (SBX-GOLD). Costs 1 credit per call.

product.description: A product id from /gold/products, e.g. gram-24k or ceyrek.

name: gold_getGoldPriceHistory
title: Gold & commodities: One product over time
